item.text: I’ll inspect the Eta configuration’s documented input format and validation behavior, then create the requested input with the appropriate handling for the unphysical \(\cos\theta^*=1.3\). I’ll only read the source and write the input plus `outcome.json`; I won’t build or run EXCLURAD.
